SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAY-09-2012 - CONTINUED PER STIPULATION OF ALL PARTIES TO MAY-23-2012 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. "DEFENDANT CLAIMS A PETITION IN BANKRUPTCY HAS BEEN FILED.
